detail.longDescription:
Can't find your TV remote again?

Turn your phone into a convenient remote for compatible smart TVs and access it directly from your home screen.

Please note: TV Remote Control For All TV is a launcher app. After installation, your home screen layout may change. Don’t worry—all your apps will remain on your phone, although some may appear in different locations. You can change your default launcher or uninstall the app at any time.

To learn more, please visit our FAQ section: https://newelapp.xyz/faq.html

With this launcher app, you also get:

⚡ One-tap remote access
Open your TV remote directly from your home screen with just one tap—no need to search through your apps.

📱 Home screen widget
Keep useful tools such as the time, weather, and news conveniently within view on your customized home screen.

🖼️ Wallpapers
Personalize your home screen or lock screen with a selection of beautiful themed wallpapers.

🔍 Multi-touchpoint search
Search for installed apps or the web (powered by Google) from multiple access points.

Your TV controls, right on your phone

TV Remote Control For All TV makes it easier to control compatible smart TVs using the phone you already have in your hand. Adjust the volume, change channels, navigate menus, and manage playback without searching for the physical remote.

Use it when your remote is missing, out of reach, or simply less convenient than your phone.

Here's why you'll love this free app:

• Adjust the volume and change channels where supported
• Navigate TV menus directly from your phone
• Quickly return to the channels and content 
• Connect to a compatible smart TV in just a few simple steps
• Control compatible TVs around your home from one convenient app
• Works with many popular smart TV brands and platforms, including Roku, Samsung, Google TV, TCL, and more
• Keep a useful backup remote available whenever you need it

Download TV Remote Control For All TV and enjoy convenient TV control directly from your home screen.

By installing TV Remote Control For All TV from the Google Play™ Store, you agree to the app's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You can change your default launcher or uninstall the app at any time through your device settings.

Please note: Your phone and TV may need to be connected to the same Wi-Fi network. Available controls, features, and compatibility vary by TV brand, model, region, and platform.

TV Remote Control For All TV is an independent application and is not affiliated with any of the TV brands or platforms mentioned above.
